issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: lectern, bookshelf, cornflower, candle, red_wall_banner.
443 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.levels: Clear new job: the stacks fill with bookshelves and a lectern, plus shutters, flower boxes, red banners and lanterns on the front.
notes.roof: Steep 45-degree roof with one block of overhang on all four sides (eaves at x1/x9, z0/z10), dark oak eaves and ridge stripe: the automatic overhang warning is a false alarm.
notes.shape: Still one rectangle under one roof; the chimney and the corner buttresses are the only breaks.
notes.materials: Stone brick, cobble base, spruce and dark oak; the white terracotta in the back gable reads slightly pinkish but does not clash.

visual.summary: Adds the bookshelves in the stacks, a lectern, candles, hanging lanterns, shutters, flower boxes and red banners: now clearly a library.
problems: Reach: the whole hall floor is reached; only roof slopes, bookshelf tops and stair tops are unreached - fine.
